---
title: "DESCRIPTION authors"
description: "Suggests adding new contributors to DESCRIPTION."
---

`check-description-authors.yml` looks at every commit of the pull request
and checks whether its author is credited in `DESCRIPTION`. Missing people
are added with the role `aut` and proposed as a
[suggestion PR](suggestions.qmd) into your branch.

Authors are resolved to the **name on their GitHub profile**, not the name
in their local git configuration, so a GitHub handle doesn't end up next to
an existing "Real Name" entry. Commits without a linked GitHub account use
the git author name. Bots such as `dependabot[bot]` or
`github-actions[bot]` are skipped; the list lives in
`config/bot-authors.json` and can be [overridden](suggestions.qmd#adjusting-the-guidance).

::: {.callout-note}
The full name is added as the given name. Split it into given and family
name in the suggestion PR before merging if you need that.
:::
